court_cases: Multiple civil/commercial proceedings, all in Calcutta High Court, all arising from a single contractual/arbitration dispute with Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW, a Government of India PSU under Indian Railways). Arihant Electricals appears as the CONTRACTOR/SUPPLIER (claimant/respondent in arbitration), CLW as the buyer. Cases identified: AP/9/2022 and AP/114/2022 (orders 15.03.2022 and 21.04.2022, Benches Prakash Shrivastava and Shekhar B. Saraf); AP-COM/728/2024 (order 27.08.2024, Justice Sabyasachi Bhattacharyya) — record notes an earlier arbitral award was passed and subsequently set aside under Section 34; AP-COM/683/2024, AP-COM/706/2024, AP-COM/910/2024 and AP-COM/960/2024 (orders 11.02.2025, 27.03.2025, 14.08.2025, 02.12.2025 and 31.08.2026, Justice Shampa Sarkar / Justice Gaurang Kanth). Status: pending/ongoing as of the latest available orders (31.08.2026). No criminal proceedings found against the company. Separately, an income-tax matter exists for a DIFFERENT entity of the same name — 'Arihant Electricals, New Delhi' vs ACIT, ITAT Delhi, Cross Objection No.245/Del/2012 (in ITA 2539/Del/12), A.Y. 2005-06, order dated 23.02.2016 — this is a tax appeal, not a criminal case, and identity with the subject company is NOT established. Sources: indiankanoon.org search results for "Arihant Electricals" (108 documents) and "Arihant Electricals" + "Chittaranjan Locomotive Works" (25 documents).
news_risk: No adverse regulatory action, no negative press, no enforcement notice found. Searches on Indian Kanoon and OpenSanctions returned nothing of a regulatory or reputational nature. The only 'risk' signal is ordinary commercial litigation volume against a state buyer — a contract-payment/arbitration pattern, not misconduct. Note: general web/news search engines were partly unavailable during this check (searx backend down, Bing returning irrelevant results, Google 429), so negative-news coverage cannot be declared exhaustively cleared — treat news_risk as 'none found in the sources reachable', not as a certified clean bill.
